title: Exponential-integrator phi functions as Hermite divided differences of exp at repeated 0
expression_sketch:
Entire family used by exponential integrators (Hochbruck-Ostermann):
  phi_0(z) = exp(z),
  phi_k(z) = 1/(k-1)! * Integral(exp((1-theta)*z) * theta**(k-1), (theta, 0, 1))  for k >= 1,
  phi_k(0) = 1/k!,
  phi_{k}(z) = (phi_{k-1}(z) - phi_{k-1}(0))/z   for z != 0.
Closed low orders:
  phi_1(z) = (exp(z)-1)/z,
  phi_2(z) = (exp(z)-1-z)/z**2,
  phi_3(z) = (exp(z)-1-z-z**2/2)/z**3.
Divided-difference identification with F(w) = exp(w):
  phi_1(z) = exp[0, z],
  phi_2(z) = exp[0, 0, z],
  phi_k(z) = exp[0^{(k)}, z]   (0 of multiplicity k, plus the simple node z).
Piecewise unification: the z != 0 quotient and the value 1/k! at z = 0 are the same analytic function (R4 + R3).
latent_structure: A family of special functions arising in stiff ODE / exponential-integrator SciML is secretly the Newton/Hermite divided-difference table of a single master F(w)=exp(w) with nodes {0 with multiplicity k} union {z}. The recurrence phi_k = (phi_{k-1} - phi_{k-1}(0))/z is the DD recurrence. The integral representation is the Hermite-Genocchi formula for those nodes.

function_domains.phi_k: entire on C for each k >= 0; phi_k(0) = 1/k!

nonzero_conditions.statement: The Newton quotient form uses z != 0; the value at 0 is the separate member phi_k(0)=1/k!

branch_conventions: No branch: exp and phi_k are entire. The symbol (e^z-1)/z is the entire continuation, not a principal-value cut.

why_not_cse_lgg: CSE may factor exp(z) but will not identify (e^z-1)/z, (e^z-1-z)/z**2, and 1, 1/2 as one Hermite table of exp. LGG cannot unify the z!=0 quotient with the z=0 derivative without a confluence/Hermite constructor. The representation is a change of head from a family of phi_k to operators on exp.
proposer_leak_risk: Hide: phi-function, exponential integrator, Hermite, Newton DD, Hochbruck, divided difference, confluence. Show the expanded quotients and the values at 0 as unlabeled catalog members. Do not name phi_k in proposer-visible text.
notes: SciML role: exponential integrators, phi-functions in Neural ODE stiff solvers, ETD methods. Catalog: G0001=(exp(z)-1)/z; G0002=1; G0003=(exp(z)-1-z)/z**2; G0004=1/2. F(w)=exp(w). Operators: newton_dd({0,z}), hermite_dd({0,0,z}). SymPy: limit phi_1=1, phi_2=1/2; (phi_1-1)/z = phi_2; Integral(exp((1-theta)*z),(theta,0,1)) = phi_1.
